purpose: Define the minimum product architecture for a durable Agent owner or the Universal SYSTEM_INFRA control plane without requiring one specific agent framework.

skill.principle: Skill should route, load progressive references and state hard boundaries; executable business logic belongs in runtime/workflow/guards rather than duplicated prose.

runtime.principle: A Skill, prompt, configured role or code stub alone is not an executable Agent runtime. A formal tool surface is optional when the owner is repository-native or otherwise has no callable API.

workflow.principle: Durable stage/state truth and transition guards must live outside chat prose.

harness.principle: Owner Harness evaluates domain contract/trajectory/quality. Universal evaluates the shared Agent architecture contract so owners do not copy the same architecture checker into every repository.

references.principle: Large domain knowledge is progressively loaded from canonical references, not copied into the hot-path Skill.

continuity.principle: Recovery and capability metadata are durable pointers; they do not replace business runtime state.

freshness.rule: Architecture validation is stale when the externally observed owner HEAD differs from the HEAD validated by the latest architecture receipt.
